description: Guided decision logic for CBP. No member, claim, or enrollment data is read anywhere in this tree -- every node consumes only the facts a user supplies for the specific scenario being discussed.

route_by_question_type.description: Route to the relevant sub-tree based on the user's question.

options.label: Is this member in the denominator? (entry / event criteria)
Does something exclude this member from the denominator?

check_htn_dx_1.context: Checking the FIRST qualifying hypertension diagnosis

check_htn_dx_1_date.context: Confirming the first diagnosis falls on/before June 30

check_htn_dx_2.context: Checking the SECOND qualifying hypertension diagnosis (a distinct date from the first)

check_htn_dx_2_date.context: Confirming the second diagnosis falls on/before December 31

check_age_66_plus.context: Confirming the age precondition for the combined frailty plus advanced illness exclusion

check_reading_setting.note: THE "I don't know where the reading was taken" SCENARIO. OPEN_CONDITION does not end the tree here -- it proceeds to the modifier and BP-threshold checks with the reading provisionally included, and the setting question is carried forward as a flagged open condition into whichever conclusion leaf is reached.

check_bp_controlled.note: The one node where OPEN_CONDITION cannot route forward -- there is no partial numeric threshold test. This is the single legitimate "I can't determine this without both numbers" leaf in the whole tree.

conclude_in_denominator.explanation: Two qualifying hypertension diagnoses were confirmed, correctly timed -- member enters the denominator (pending exclusion checks).

conclude_dx_not_qualifying.explanation: This diagnosis code is not in the Essential Hypertension value set, so it cannot count toward entry criteria.

conclude_first_dx_too_late.explanation: This diagnosis is a valid hypertension code, but its date is after June 30 -- it cannot serve as the FIRST qualifying event.

conclude_only_one_qualifying_dx.explanation: Only one qualifying hypertension diagnosis was confirmed. A second, distinct qualifying diagnosis on/before December 31 is required.

conclude_second_dx_too_late.explanation: The second diagnosis falls after December 31 of the measurement year and cannot count.

conclude_open_entry_criteria.explanation: Entry criteria cannot be fully confirmed or ruled out with the facts given -- see flagged open condition(s).

conclude_excluded_esrd_dx.explanation: This diagnosis is an ESRD code -> the member is excluded from the denominator.

conclude_excluded_esrd_px.explanation: This procedure indicates ESRD (dialysis/transplant/nephrectomy) -> the member is excluded.

conclude_excluded_pregnancy.explanation: Pregnancy diagnosis present during the measurement year -> the member is excluded.

conclude_excluded_hospice.explanation: Hospice indicator present -> the member is excluded.

conclude_excluded_nonacute.explanation: Non-acute inpatient stay present during the measurement year -> the member is excluded.

conclude_excluded_frailty_advanced_illne.explanation: Both frailty and advanced illness indicators are present (member 66+) -> the member is excluded. This exclusion requires BOTH -- either alone does not trigger it.

conclude_no_exclusions_found.explanation: None of the checked exclusion criteria were met based on the facts given. This does not guarantee no exclusion exists -- only that the ones checked here don't apply.

conclude_open_exclusion.explanation: This exclusion cannot be confirmed or ruled out with the facts given -- see flagged open condition(s). Other exclusions and the numerator can still be evaluated independently.

conclude_reading_not_usable_timing.explanation: This reading predates the second qualifying hypertension diagnosis and cannot serve as the representative reading.

conclude_reading_excluded_setting.explanation: This reading was taken during an acute inpatient stay or ED visit and cannot be used for the numerator.

conclude_reading_excluded_modifier.explanation: This reading carries a CPT Category II exception modifier (1P/2P/8P) and cannot be used for the numerator.

conclude_numerator_compliant.explanation: Systolic < 140 AND diastolic < 90 on the representative reading -> numerator compliant.

conclude_numerator_not_compliant.explanation: The representative reading does not meet the <140/<90 threshold -> not numerator compliant.

conclude_open_numerator_math.explanation: Systolic and/or diastolic values were not provided -- a numeric compliance answer isn't possible without both. Everything else evaluated along this path still stands.
